name: Evangelical Covenant Church

citations.excerpt: The Evangelical Covenant Church, a Swedish Pietist church, was founded in 1885 as a merger of the Swedish Lutheran Mission Synod and the Swedish Lutheran Ansgarius Synod to form the Swedish Evangelical Mission Covenant Church of America.

facts.value: A Swedish Pietist church in the United States, founded in 1885 by a merger of two Swedish Lutheran synods. Its name was shortened in stages in 1937, 1957 and 1983.

citations.excerpt: In 1937, the "Swedish" was dropped; in 1957, the word "mission" was dropped; and in 1983, the words "of America" were dropped.
